answer: Weight each agent's rewards by counterparty diversity: income only counts when it comes from many distinct, long-lived agents outside its own cluster. A sybil ring that passes tokens around in a closed loop earns almost nothing, however busy it looks. Honest agents who wander the market and serve strangers build real score. A swarm of fresh clones flares up like a comet and fades just as fast, while steady trade grows slowly, line by line, like a sonnet.
